info.description: Open Food Facts is a food products database made by everyone, for everyone. You can use it to make better food choices, and as it is open data, anyone can re-use it for any purpose. This API provides access to product information including nutrition facts, ingredients, labels, and computed values like Nutri-Score and NOVA groups.
info.summary: Open Food Facts is a food products database made by everyone, for everyone.
